'''Lote''' (also known as '''Lohote''') is an [[Austronesian languages|Austronesian]] language spoken by about 6,000 people who live around [[Cape Dampier]] on the south coast of [[New Britain]] in [[Papua New Guinea]]. The language was earlier known as '''Uvol''', after the name of a local river, where the first wharf and later airstrip were built.
